description: TypeScript declaration for the MockPool class, which extends the Pool class and implements Interceptable, providing methods to mock HTTP requests, intercept calls, dispatch mock requests, and manage mock lifecycle.

classes.name: MockPool
classes.description: A class extending Pool that facilitates mocking HTTP requests, intercepting calls, dispatching mocks, and cleanup.

methods.name: constructor (origin: string, options: MockPool.Options) constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new MockPool instance with specified origin and options.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Sets up interception for matching requests within this mock pool.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a mocked request using the specified options and handlers.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the mock pool gracefully after completing all enqueued requests.

methods.name: cleanMocks
methods.description: Removes all prepared mock interceptors and resets the mock pool state.

ctags.name: MockPool
ctags.pattern: /^declare class MockPool extends Pool implements Interceptable {$/
